share.whoFor: Who it's for (only you see this)
sources.alwaysSkipped: Synology's own folders (@eaDir, #recycle), Mac and Windows clutter and Lightroom caches are always skipped. Removing a folder keeps its photos here, marked missing.
sources.anyNas: Any NAS that runs Docker containers works, on Intel, AMD or ARM. A WD My Cloud or Buffalo can't run them: use the Mac or Windows steps on a computer that sees its shared folders instead.
sources.codeUnknown: That code is unknown or has expired.
sources.composeFailed: Could not load the compose file ({status}).
sources.copyFailed: Could not copy: select the text and copy it yourself.
sources.disconnectTitle: Its key stops working at once. Connecting it again means pairing again, as a new agent.
sources.getsBack: It gets back its entry, folders and photos, and carries on from its own list of files.
sources.getsBackOwn: It gets back its entry, folders and photos, and carries on from its own list of files (it says this was its entry).
sources.installNode: Install Node.js 24 (the LTS installer) from nodejs.org, if it isn't there already.
sources.macNote: It takes this Mac’s name, starts at login and only reads your photos. When macOS asks whether node may read your Pictures folder, drives or network volumes, allow it.
sources.noFolders: Nothing indexed yet. Choose a folder the agent can see.
sources.none: Nothing connected yet. A small helper runs on your NAS or computer, reads your photos where they are, and sends their metadata and previews here. Originals stay where they are until you decide to move them.
sources.offlineTitle: Unplugged or unmounted. Its photos stay here; connect it to update them.
sources.openLocal: Open http://localhost:8790 on that computer. It shows an eight-letter code.
sources.pasteAsIs: Paste it as it is: there's nothing to change. It lets the helper read your NAS's drive (never change or delete anything on it), and in the next steps you choose which photo folders it catalogues, from a list. It needs about 1 GB of memory.
sources.previewsLaterTitle: Sent with a thumbnail first, so they show sooner. Their large previews follow once every thumbnail is in.
sources.restoredWaiting: Brought back from a backup, without its key. Once refused a few times, the agent pairs again by itself and shows a new code (in its log and on its status page). Enter it under Add a computer or NAS and connect it as “{name}” again.
sources.scanFailed: Could not start a scan on “{name}”
sources.startIt: Start it. The agent's log (and its page at http://your-nas:8790) shows an eight-letter code.

sources.unzipWindows: Unzip the helper, open PowerShell in its folder and run:
sources.waitingAgent: Agent “{name}” is waiting. Connecting gives it a key that can only send photos to this archive.
sources.waitingAgentOn: Agent “{name}” on {platform} is waiting. Connecting gives it a key that can only send photos to this archive.
sources.windowsNote: It starts when you sign in, as you, so it sees your mapped drives and shares. It only reads your photos.
sourcesPage.subtitle: Index photos where they live. Originals stay on the computer or NAS; cf-dam gets their metadata and previews.
storage.alreadyRestored: Already restored; the restore was extended.
storage.cls.NAS: On a computer or NAS (indexed in place)
storage.minimumStay: S3 bills a minimum stay: 30 days for the IA classes, 90 for Glacier, 180 for Deep Archive.
storage.missing: Missing: not found in the last scan (moved or deleted)
storage.offline: Offline since {date}. To reach the original, connect {what} to {source}.
storage.restoreRequested: Restore requested. Check back in a few hours; the copy stays available for {days}.
storage.stays: The original stays where it is. cf-dam has its metadata and previews; lifecycle rules (Phase 6) will move originals to cloud storage.
storage.staysOn: The original stays where it is, on {source}. cf-dam has its metadata and previews; lifecycle rules (Phase 6) will move originals to cloud storage.
storage.tier.Bulk: Bulk: cheapest, Flexible 5–12 h, Deep Archive within 48 h
storage.tier.Standard: Standard: Flexible 3–5 h, Deep Archive within 12 h
storagePage.subtitle: Where originals live. Thumbnails and previews always stay in the built-in R2 bucket.
timeline.label: Timeline
tools.cropHint: Drag a corner to crop, or inside the box to move it. The original file is never changed; Reset and Save undoes the edit.
tools.cutoutNote: Removing the background is done by Cloudflare’s AI and works best on a clear subject.
tools.loadFailed: Could not load the picture to edit.
tools.xmpTitle: Keywords, captions, rating and credits in a file Lightroom, Capture One and Bridge read
twoFactor.noMatch: That code did not match. Check the time on your phone and try the next code.
twoFactor.offFailed: Could not turn off two-factor sign-in.
twoFactor.offLead: Add a code from an authenticator app to every sign-in.
twoFactor.onLead: Sign-in asks for a code from your authenticator app.
twoFactor.saveCodes: Save these backup codes somewhere safe. Each one works once if you lose your phone. They won't be shown again.
twoFactor.scan: Scan this with your authenticator app, then enter the code it shows.
twoFactor.startFailed: Could not start enrolment. Check your password.
upload.deep: Straight to deep archive: your browser makes the preview before the original leaves, because nothing can read it back for hours. Getting the original later takes a restore.
upload.drop: Drop photos, RAW files and video here
upload.dropLead: or click to choose. Large files upload in parts, up to 5 TB each.
upload.networkPart: Network error on part {part}. If this is an S3 bucket, check its CORS rule allows PUT from this site.
upload.noEtag: Storage did not expose the ETag header. Add ETag to the bucket CORS rule’s ExposeHeaders.
upload.noPreviewVideo: Uploaded without a preview (this browser couldn’t read the video)
wm.removed: Watermark removed. Galleries show photos without one.
wm.roughly: Roughly how clients will see it
wm.saved: Watermark saved. Galleries with the watermark on use it from now on.
wm.upload: Or upload your logo (a PNG with a transparent background works best)
